Name: Animal Crossing Plushies
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
had this idea for a while and just got around to it~ there are currently 35 villager plushies and 2 main character plushies (tom nook and isabelle) but ill probably add more in the future!

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install alternative textures
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ how to use: purchase the paint bucket from robin and use it on the large futan bear to change it to any animal crossing plushie of your choosing
♡ includes peanut, marshal, filbert, bob, punchy, raymond, tangy, sasha, chrissy, francine, ankha, merry, isabelle, tom nook, diana, fauna, bunnie, hopkins, rosie, lobo, roald, dom, muffy, vesta, coco, megan, pietro, faith, cherry, beau, fang, mitzi, lolly, pate, molly, poppy, kabuki and katt
♡ sprites made by me
